0.0: Hello, #h0#! I promised you a gift at Lv. 20, didn't I? Well, it's right here, since you started after 02/05/13. Want it now?

no.0: Oh, you don't want a gift? Okay. Talk to me if you change your mind.

yes.0: Open your Inventory and double-click on your gift! It's full of wonderful items that I just know you'll love! And there's more to be had when you get to Lv. 30. Good luck!
